vcu_g_0159_2000102c.name: vehicle_tick100_counter
vcu_g_0159_2000102c.description: 16-bit counter used in two ways. vcu_periodic_100_tick_check counts its calls up to 100 and resets it, raising DAT_20001fc0 on the wrap if its conditions hold; vcu_fault_warning_evaluate counts it up to 300 and 500 for fault timing. vcu_0159_080054ec clears it. Probably one count per main-loop tick.

vcu_g_0159_2000134c.name: vehicle_event_a_prev
vcu_g_0159_2000134c.description: Previous copy of the event/input byte DAT_20001fbc, kept by vcu_event_countdown_a. When the live value differs, the countdown vehicle_countdown_a is reloaded. Written only by that function.

vcu_g_0159_2000134d.name: vehicle_event_b_prev
vcu_g_0159_2000134d.description: Previous copy of the event/input byte DAT_20001fbc, kept by vcu_event_countdown_b. When the live value differs, the countdown vehicle_countdown_b is reloaded.

vcu_g_0159_2000135c.name: vehicle_cycle_mode_state
vcu_g_0159_2000135c.description: 3-state cycle selector (0, 1 or 2), stepped by each request in vcu_cycle_mode_on_request. It is mapped to vehicle_drive_cycle_mode (DAT_20001b94), which vcu_drive_command_update packs into the drive command word.

vcu_g_0159_2000137c.name: vehicle_angle_counter_prev
vcu_g_0159_2000137c.description: Previous value of vehicle_angle_counter (DAT_20001b84), kept by vcu_angle_deg_update. When the counter has changed, the angle in degrees (vehicle_angle_deg) is recomputed. Present in VCU_14b to 0159.

vcu_g_0159_20001384.name: vehicle_tick100_prescaler
vcu_g_0159_20001384.description: Divide-by-100 prescaler advanced by vcu_timebase_100_tick. It counts 0 to 99 and wraps; each wrap advances the saturating elapsed counters vehicle_elapsed_time_a, vehicle_elapsed_time_b, vehicle_elapsed_time_c and vehicle_angle_period. Cleared only by the wrap itself.

vcu_g_0159_20001388.name: vehicle_wheel_angle_acc
vcu_g_0159_20001388.description: Accumulated wheel angle, updated by vcu_wheel_odometer_limit_update by adding the per-tick increment DAT_20001b62 (probably speed-derived). Probably in thousandths of a degree: it wraps by subtracting 360000 (one turn) when it exceeds 359999.

vcu_g_14a_20001389.name: vehicle_ready_flag_a_v14a
vcu_g_14a_20001389.description: Ready-sequence flag A of builds 148 and 14a, set to 1 and cleared to 0 by vcu_ready_sequence_step_v148_14a in its two phases. Probably the ready request that gates the arm and run states.

vcu_g_14a_2000138a.name: vehicle_ready_latch_b_v14a
vcu_g_14a_2000138a.description: Ready-sequence latch of builds 148 and 14a. It is set when status bytes DAT_20001e90 and DAT_20001e8f are both 1 while the latch is clear, and it is cleared in the other phase.

vcu_g_14a_2000138b.name: vehicle_run_latch_v14a
vcu_g_14a_2000138b.description: Run latch of builds 148 and 14a, set and cleared by vcu_ready_sequence_step_v148_14a. Run conditions include DAT_20001ee4 equal to 3 and the speed value DAT_20001da6/100 above 30.

vcu_g_14a_2000138c.name: vehicle_arm_latch_v14a
vcu_g_14a_2000138c.description: Arm latch of builds 148 and 14a, set to 1 in three places of vcu_ready_sequence_step_v148_14a. Its clear path is not in this packet.

vcu_g_0159_2000138d.name: vehicle_ready_flag_a
vcu_g_0159_2000138d.description: Ready-sequence flag A of builds 14b to 0159, set and cleared by vcu_ready_sequence_step_v14b_0159. Same role as vehicle_ready_flag_a_v14a.

vcu_g_0159_2000138e.name: vehicle_ready_latch_b
vcu_g_0159_2000138e.description: Ready-sequence latch of builds 14b to 0159. It is set when status flags DAT_20001f50 and DAT_20001f4f are both 1 while the latch is clear; it is cleared when both are 0.

vcu_g_0159_2000138f.name: vehicle_run_latch
vcu_g_0159_2000138f.description: Run latch of builds 14b to 0159, set and cleared by vcu_ready_sequence_step_v14b_0159. Run conditions include DAT_20001fa4 equal to 3 and the speed value DAT_20001e66/100 above 30.

vcu_g_0159_20001390.name: vehicle_arm_latch
vcu_g_0159_20001390.description: Arm latch of builds 14b to 0159, set to 1 in three places of vcu_ready_sequence_step_v14b_0159. Its clear path is not in this packet.

vcu_g_0159_20001391.name: vehicle_status_f4f_prev
vcu_g_0159_20001391.description: Previous copy of status flag DAT_20001f4f, used by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval for edge detection. The copy is taken only when the flag changes.

vcu_g_0159_20001392.name: vehicle_derate_limit_a
vcu_g_0159_20001392.description: Limit constant 0xB4 (180) written by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval in VCU_0159. Used as a threshold against the derate input; probably the upper limit of a range check.

vcu_g_152_20001392.name: vehicle_derate_limit_a_v152
vcu_g_152_20001392.description: Limit constant 0xB4 (180) written by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval in VCU_152, at the same address as vehicle_derate_limit_a in VCU_0159.

vcu_g_0159_20001393.name: vehicle_derate_limit_b
vcu_g_0159_20001393.description: Upper limit written by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval: 0xDC (220) in one branch and 0xD7 (215) in the other. Used as the upper bound of a range check whose lower bound is 30 (0x1E).

vcu_g_14f_20001393.name: vehicle_derate_limit_b_v14f
vcu_g_14f_20001393.description: Upper limit written by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval in VCU_14f: 0xDC (220) or 0xD7 (215). Same use as vehicle_derate_limit_b in VCU_0159.

vcu_g_0159_20001394.name: vehicle_derate_limit_c
vcu_g_0159_20001394.description: Constant 0x3C (60) written by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval in VCU_0159 (the 153 variant at the same address holds the same value). Probably a limit in the same units as the derate input.

vcu_g_153_20001394.name: vehicle_derate_limit_c_v153
vcu_g_153_20001394.description: Constant 0x3C (60) written by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval in VCU_153. Same meaning as vehicle_derate_limit_c in VCU_0159.

vcu_g_0159_20001395.name: vehicle_derate_limit_d
vcu_g_0159_20001395.description: Upper limit written by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval: 0xDC (220) or 0xD7 (215). Used as the upper bound of a second range check (lower bound 30).

vcu_g_0159_20001396.name: vehicle_derate_limit_e
vcu_g_0159_20001396.description: Constant 0xB4 (180) written by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval in VCU_0159 (VCU_14e and VCU_153 hold the same value at the same address). Same kind of threshold as vehicle_derate_limit_a.

vcu_g_14e_20001396.name: vehicle_derate_limit_e_v14e
vcu_g_14e_20001396.description: Constant 0xB4 (180) written by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval in VCU_14e. Same meaning as vehicle_derate_limit_e.

vcu_g_153_20001396.name: vehicle_derate_limit_e_v153
vcu_g_153_20001396.description: Constant 0xB4 (180) written by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval in VCU_153. Same meaning as vehicle_derate_limit_e.

vcu_g_0159_20001399.name: vehicle_input_b_prev
vcu_g_0159_20001399.description: Previous copy of the input-B state byte DAT_200021c1. vcu_input_b_hold_start_tick compares the live byte with this copy to detect a change, then refreshes it.

vcu_g_0159_2000139a.name: vehicle_input_b_hold_latch
vcu_g_0159_2000139a.description: Latch of the input-B hold sequence. It is cleared at the start of a check while DAT_2000123d is set, and set to 1 once input B is in its long-hold state 3 (DAT_200021c1 == 3). Probably tells the hold-to-start action that the hold has happened.

vcu_g_0159_2000139b.name: vehicle_derate_low_byte_ref
vcu_g_0159_2000139b.description: Reference copy of the low byte of vehicle_derate_word. vcu_input_b_hold_start_tick sets it to 0x30 (48) and reloads it from the live low byte when that byte exceeds it by more than 10, so it tracks the derate value with hysteresis.

vcu_g_0159_2000139c.name: vehicle_input_b_seq_flag_a
vcu_g_0159_2000139c.description: Flag of the input-B hold sequence, written 0 and then 1 by vcu_input_b_hold_start_tick. Probably marks the start and end of a hold.

vcu_g_0159_2000139d.name: vehicle_input_b_seq_flag_b
vcu_g_0159_2000139d.description: Flag of the input-B hold sequence, cleared in two places and tested by vcu_input_b_hold_start_tick before it acts.

vcu_g_14a_200013a4.name: vehicle_ready_timeout_a_v14a
vcu_g_14a_200013a4.description: Tick counter of builds 148 and 14a, incremented every tick by vcu_ready_sequence_step_v148_14a. It is cleared when a condition fails or when it passes 1000 ticks, which ends the wait.

vcu_g_0159_200013a6.name: vehicle_ready_timeout_a
vcu_g_0159_200013a6.description: Tick counter of builds 14b to 0159, incremented by vcu_ready_sequence_step_v14b_0159. It is cleared when a comparison fails or when it passes 1000 ticks.

vcu_g_14a_200013a6.name: vehicle_ready_counter_b_v14a
vcu_g_14a_200013a6.description: Counter of builds 148 and 14a in vcu_ready_sequence_step_v148_14a. It counts up and resets when it passes 100.

vcu_g_0159_200013a8.name: vehicle_ready_counter_b
vcu_g_0159_200013a8.description: Counter of builds 14b to 0159 in vcu_ready_sequence_step_v14b_0159. It counts up and resets when it passes 100.

vcu_g_14a_200013a8.name: vehicle_ready_counter_c_v14a
vcu_g_14a_200013a8.description: Counter of builds 148 and 14a in vcu_ready_sequence_step_v148_14a. It counts up and resets when it passes 249 (0xF9).

vcu_g_0159_200013aa.name: vehicle_ready_counter_c
vcu_g_0159_200013aa.description: Counter of builds 14b to 0159 in vcu_ready_sequence_step_v14b_0159. It counts up and resets when it passes 249 (0xF9).

vcu_g_14a_200013aa.name: vehicle_ready_counter_d_v14a
vcu_g_14a_200013aa.description: Counter of builds 148 and 14a, counting while DAT_20001e90 is 0. It ends the wait when it passes 3000 ticks and resets otherwise.

vcu_g_0159_200013ac.name: vehicle_ready_counter_d
vcu_g_0159_200013ac.description: Counter of builds 14b to 0159, counting while DAT_20001f50 is 0. It ends the wait when it passes 3000 ticks and resets otherwise.

vcu_g_14a_200013ac.name: vehicle_ready_counter_e_v14a
vcu_g_14a_200013ac.description: Counter of builds 148 and 14a, counting while DAT_20001e8f is 1. It resets when it passes 100.

vcu_g_0159_200013ae.name: vehicle_ready_counter_e
vcu_g_0159_200013ae.description: Counter of builds 14b to 0159, counting while DAT_20001f4f is 1. It resets when it passes 100.

vcu_g_0159_200013b2.name: vehicle_input_b_counter_a
vcu_g_0159_200013b2.description: Counter of the input-B hold sequence, incremented by vcu_input_b_hold_start_tick. It resets when it passes 10 ticks.

vcu_g_0159_200013b4.name: vehicle_input_b_counter_b
vcu_g_0159_200013b4.description: Second counter of the input-B hold sequence, cleared and incremented by vcu_input_b_hold_start_tick.

vcu_g_0159_200013d4.name: vehicle_revolution_mark_prev
vcu_g_0159_200013d4.description: Copy of vehicle_wheel_revolutions taken by vcu_revolution_stage_tracker. It holds the revolution count of the last stage mark.

vcu_g_0159_200013d8.name: vehicle_revolution_stage_ref
vcu_g_0159_200013d8.description: Reference value compared with vehicle_wheel_revolutions by vcu_revolution_stage_tracker. It is loaded from vehicle_revolution_snapshot (DAT_20001c88) and gates the next stage mark.

vcu_g_153_200014be.name: vehicle_level_hold_count
vcu_g_153_200014be.description: Count of consecutive ticks on which the level value shifted right by 4 is at least 60. vcu_level_hold_latch sets its latch after ten such ticks and clears the count otherwise.

vcu_g_0159_200014c9.name: vehicle_sensor_high_count
vcu_g_0159_200014c9.description: Count of sustained high readings of the sensor words in vcu_sensor_threshold_pulse_count. It saturates at 100 and resets when a reading is low.

vcu_g_0159_200014d8.name: vehicle_sensor_burst_timer
vcu_g_0159_200014d8.description: Countdown in ticks, reloaded to 300 by vcu_sensor_threshold_pulse_count. It stops at 0; the burst message is sent when it runs out.

vcu_g_0159_20001836.name: vehicle_speed_snapshot_counter
vcu_g_0159_20001836.description: Counter in vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update. It counts up to 11 ticks and is reset to 0 when it passes 10, which paces the periodic telemetry snapshot.

vcu_g_0159_20001875.name: vehicle_condition_b_latch
vcu_g_0159_20001875.description: Latch set to 1 by vcu_condition_b_latch_flags when the status conditions hold. vcu_timed_window_schedule_tick clears it only while bit 4 of DAT_20001af2 is set.

vcu_g_0159_20001880.name: vehicle_debounce_a_count
vcu_g_0159_20001880.description: Debounce counter of vcu_debounce_condition_a. It counts up to 20 (0x14) while the condition holds and steps back otherwise; it drives the output flag DAT_20001f69.

vcu_g_14b_20001a30.name: vehicle_speed_mode_source_v14b
vcu_g_14b_20001a30.description: Byte read by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update in builds 148, 14a and 14b. No decompiled line names it directly (accessed through a pointer); its meaning is not decoded.

vcu_g_0159_20001ab4.name: vehicle_config_block
vcu_g_0159_20001ab4.description: Address-taken block of 46 bytes at 0x20001AB4 (probably the mode and configuration record that is loaded and saved in flash). About a dozen functions take its address, including vcu_config_ab_slot_load and vcu_flash_record_pingpong_save. The fields are not decoded here and the end of the block is assumed to be before 0x20001AE2.

vcu_g_14a_20001ace.name: vehicle_angle_legacy_v14a
vcu_g_14a_20001ace.description: Angle in degrees, computed by vcu_angle_deg_calc_legacy as (DAT_20001ac4 * 360) / DAT_20001ac8, and set to 0 when the divisor is 0. Used only in builds 148 and 14a.

vcu_g_0159_20001ae2.name: vehicle_build_id
vcu_g_0159_20001ae2.description: Build identifier word, set to 0x0159 by vcu_0159_08009da8. It is read by can_get_tx_payload_for_id and sent in the telemetry frame built by vcu_0159_080054ec.

vcu_g_0159_20001ae8.name: vehicle_telemetry_word_b
vcu_g_0159_20001ae8.description: 16-bit value copied to the telemetry snapshot (DAT_200033a0) by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update. Present in VCU_14e to 0159; its source is not decoded here.

vcu_g_0159_20001aec.name: vehicle_status_word_a
vcu_g_0159_20001aec.description: Packed status flags word A. Bit 2 is set and cleared by vcu_condition_b_latch_flags, and bit 11 is tested by vcu_fault_0f_update and vcu_ready_sequence_step_v14b_0159. Many ready, fault and input routines read this word.

vcu_g_0159_20001aee.name: vehicle_status_word_b
vcu_g_0159_20001aee.description: Packed status flags word B. Bit 3 is cleared or set by app_apply_mode_limits, and other bits are used by the alert, toggle and pulse routines (for example vcu_alert_tone_sequencer and vcu_toggle_special_mode).

vcu_g_0159_20001af0.name: vehicle_status_word_c
vcu_g_0159_20001af0.description: Packed status flags word C. Bit 6 is cleared by vcu_key_sequence_entry_tick, and bits 7, 11 and 14 are tested by the key, derate and pulse routines.

vcu_g_0159_20001b06.name: vehicle_mode_limit_g
vcu_g_0159_20001b06.description: 16-bit word whose address is taken by app_apply_mode_limits. No direct access was seen, so it is probably a mode limit parameter of the same kind as vehicle_mode_limit_a.
